endpoint.description:
Returns aggregated order book data for a market, grouped by `tickSize` (tick aggregation step). The response contains `long` (bid) and `short` (ask) sides as parallel arrays: `ia[i]` is the **tick index** at level `i` — a signed integer, NOT an APR. Multiply by the requested `tickSize` to get the implied APR as a unitless decimal (e.g. `ia[i] = 316` at `tickSize = 0.0001` → `0.0316` = 3.16% APR; negative values are valid on negative-funding markets). `sz[i]` is the total notional size at that level as a **bigint string** in 18-decimal YU (yield units). Long levels are sorted descending by APR (best bid first); short levels ascending by APR (best ask first). Each side is capped at the **best 50 entries**.

**AMM merging.** When `includeAmm=true`, on-chain AMM positions are merged into the book before the 50-entry cap is applied. When `includeAmm=false` (default), only resting limit orders are returned, also capped at 50 entries per side.

**Tick size.** `tickSize` controls how raw ticks are bucketed before aggregation. See [Order Book mechanics](https://docs.pendle.finance/boros-dev/Mechanics/OrderBook) for the tick-to-rate exponential mapping and matching rules.

parameters.name: tickSize
parameters.description: Tick aggregation step. Adjacent raw ticks are grouped into a single price level before sizes are summed; larger values produce coarser, more readable books.

parameters.name: includeAmm
parameters.description: When `true`, on-chain AMM liquidity is merged into both sides of the book and each side is capped at **50** entries. When `false` (default), only resting limit orders are returned.

200.description: Order book with long and short sides (up to 50 entries each), optionally including AMM liquidity

410.description: Market has matured; its order book is no longer available (`MARKET_MATURED`)

long.description: Bid side — orders to go long on rates. Best bid first.

short.description: Ask side — orders to go short on rates. Best ask first.

syncStatus.description: Current sync status of the order book

ia.description: Implied APR at each aggregated tick level (unitless decimal, `0.085` = 8.5%). For the long side, sorted **descending** (best bid first). For the short side, sorted **ascending** (best ask first). `ia[i]` corresponds 1:1 with `sz[i]`.

sz.description: Total resting notional at the matching `ia[i]` level as a **bigint string** in 18-decimal YU (yield units). Includes AMM contribution at this level when the request used `includeAmm=true`.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the latest fully processed block
